description.en: SAGE routing plugin that scores declared agents and returns SELF, HANDOFF, or COLLABORATE decisions for a task DAG, with optional subagent execution through sage_orchestrate_task.
description.zh: SAGE 路由插件，为任务 DAG 对声明 Agent 评分并返回 SELF、HANDOFF 或 COLLABORATE 决策，可通过 sage_orchestrate_task 按需执行子 Agent 编排。
